title: Number of Good Pairs
goal: Count index pairs i < j with equal array values.
strategy: When a value arrives, pair it with every earlier equal occurrence. Counting before incrementing prevents pairing an index with itself.

phasePurposes.inspect: When a value arrives, pair it with every earlier equal occurrence. Counting before incrementing prevents pairing an index with itself.
phasePurposes.update: Each new occurrence pairs with all earlier equal values exactly once.
phasePurposes.done: Each new occurrence pairs with all earlier equal values exactly once.

inputRules: Inputs are validated against this algorithm’s domain and the documented visualization size limits.
